| Measurement | Result | What it proves |
|---|---:|---|

| Relocation-normalized machine-code matches | **7/1,041 (0.67%)** | No function is promoted to `MATCHING` without generated-object evidence. |
| Complete replacement ELF | **No** | Startup ownership, globals/types, object boundaries, linker script/order, historical archives and packing still need proof. |

## Meaning of “complete”

“Nothing left behind” is currently defensible only inside the closed structural
universe: 1,137 raw JAL-shaped targets − 292 rejected post-code data patterns +
196 independently mapped non-JAL entries = 1,041 validated entries. It does not
prove that 1,041 is the mathematically exact number of compiler-created
functions, nor that the original source has already been recovered verbatim.

The next proof ladder is documented in
[`docs/MATCHING_WORKFLOW.md`](MATCHING_WORKFLOW.md).
